description: PAID $0.003 USDC. One wallet's TWAP history and recent slice fills from Hyperliquid's official public info API. Research data, not investment advice. Requires wallet. Covered by pass_day/pass_month. No charge on failure. Returns JSON with that wallet's TWAP history and recent slice fills.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

wallet.description: Hyperliquid wallet. Format: 0x followed by 40 hex characters (42 characters total). Example: 0x85ecf584f25db6f146718b86d493e33c5af72052. Required.

name: hl_twap
title: Wallet Hyperliquid TWAP history ($0.003)
